race.description: Congrats To 2025-26 Lvtc Winning Premiership Trainer - Rex Lipp Mdn Plate
race.comment: BOLD GEM (9) has no race experience, but barrier one, the 1.5kg claim and two lead-up trials give her a genuine platform on debut. BRAZEN DIVA (2) just missed the bob from getting off the mark two back at Warwick. Less effective last time when tailing out at Eagle Farm but this is significantly easier. Low draw helps. MY SHALONA (4) returns and makes her stable debut for the Keal team. Trialled well in readiness and is worth a market watch despite the tricky draw. BAR STAR (7) is a Tassort gelding on debut for the Campton yard. Has come along nicely at the trials, stripping fitter for two, and can make his presence felt immediately.
